scene: The brass automaton twitches its brass fingers, waiting across the game board.
picture: A close first-person view of the intricately inlaid wooden chessboard filling the table. On the left rests a white wooden pawn. In the centre between the board halves sits a polished dual brass chess timer with ticking levers. On the right, a heavy carved marble rook awaits. Two brass automaton fingers hover nearby.
shown: A carved wooden white pawn sitting on a square at the left
A brass dual chess timer ticking softly in the centre
A heavy marble rook perched quietly on the right
